## Skipped tests

| Reason | Tests |
| --- | ---: |
| HL7 Java engine document functions (out of scope) | 115 |
| exception: 3.0.0 permits calendar year/month ordering after conversion; the suite expects empty ([spec notes](../spec-notes.md#ordering-calendar-years-and-months)) | 3 |
| exception: a value without an offset is UTC (ADR-0012); the suite expects empty ([spec notes](../spec-notes.md#a-value-without-a-timezone-offset-is-utc)) | 2 |
| exception: code derives from string, so as(string) and ofType(string) keep the code; the suite expects empty ([spec notes](../spec-notes.md#fhir-primitives-in-is-as-and-oftype)) | 2 |
| exception: System.Patient does not resolve, so is() raises eval/unknown-type; the suite expects false ([spec notes](../spec-notes.md#unresolved-type-specifiers-are-execution-errors)) | 1 |
| exception: the R4 copy ignores the 0.1 s fraction; Callis follows R5 and 3.0.0 ([spec notes](../spec-notes.md#fractions-in-datetime-arithmetic)) | 1 |
